summary: BTC Digital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a loan agreement with its CEO and CFO for $1M aggregate, non-convertible, unsecured, 12% simple interest, one-year maturity. The loans are denominated in USD, funded in USDT, for working capital. There is no equity component, no premium, no tender, no board recommendation or advisor. This is a routine financing not constituting a special situation.
